title: Component library manifest
description: The `azDesign.library` field of a component library's package.json. Storybook registers every package that has one.

key.description: Short id used in the toolbar global (`?globals=library:<key>`) and in story tags (`lib:<key>`).

title.description: Name shown in the toolbar and docs.

status.description: `preview` until the library is verified on its target platform, then `supported`. Preview libraries are labeled in the toolbar.

codeLanguage.description: Language of the code the adapter's `source` returns, for syntax highlighting.

readme.description: Path to the library's README, relative to its package.json.

stylesheets.description: Stylesheets the library needs on the page: absolute URLs, or paths relative to its package.json. Storybook loads them while the library is selected.

adapter.description: Subpath export of the module that renders the library's components in Storybook, e.g. `./storybook`.

ref.description: URL of a Storybook rendered by the library's own platform, for a library that can't render in this one.
